title: Collection of environmental DNA from stemflow for monitoring arboreal biodiversity
author: Sakata, Sado, et al.
materials: 3D design file (STL) of backflow prevention unit
3D design file (STL) of top of backflow prevention unit
3D design file (STL) of bottom of backflow prevention unit

steps.title: Sterilize all equipment
steps.instruction: Disinfect rubber rope, silicone funnel, hose, and backflow prevention unit with 10 % commercial bleach (≈0.6 % NaOCl), place all parts in sterilization packs, and change gloves before handling each component.

steps.title: Fabricate backflow prevention unit
steps.instruction: Design a two‑part backflow prevention unit in Fusion 360 to fit a 1‑L plastic bag, 3‑D‑print it on an ELEGOO Mars Pro 2 or Saturn SLA printer, and insert a 1 cm diameter foam polystyrene ball between the two printed parts.

steps.title: Assemble collection apparatus
steps.instruction: Gather the six components: (1) round rubber rope whose circumference equals tree trunk + 15–20 cm (IT‑9149, Itodai Seiko), (2) ~1 m gauze (Insert Care Gauze No. 1, 63‑1452‑99, Hakujuji), (3) silicone funnel (Silicone Funnel Icho, 07,438, Yamazaki), (4) hose (inner diameter 1.5 cm, ~10 cm long), (5) 1‑L plastic bag with airtight screw cap (DP16‑TN1000, Cowpack LTD), (6) backflow prevention unit.

steps.title: Install system on tree
steps.instruction: Tie the rubber rope securely around the trunk ~50 cm above ground to prevent sliding (≈10 min), thread both rope ends through the silicone funnel, wrap the gauze around the trunk and tuck its ends into the funnel, insert both rope ends into the hose, connect the hose to the backflow prevention unit attached to the plastic bag, cover the funnel opening with aluminum foil, and add 1 mL Benzalkonium chloride (Osban; 4987123116046) to the plastic bag before rainfall.

steps.title: Collect stemflow during rain
steps.instruction: Allow rainwater to run down the gauze‑wrapped trunk, through the funnel, and into the plastic bag while the backflow prevention unit blocks reverse flow.

steps.title: Retrieve gauze and prepare filtration
steps.instruction: After rain, detach the plastic bag and backflow unit from the hose, cap the backflow unit and refrigerate it, then pull the gauze off the trunk and place it into a syringe fitted with a Sterivex filter cartridge.

steps.title: Pressure‑filter gauze sample
steps.instruction: Insert the plunger into the syringe, transport to the lab, remove the plunger, add 50 mL purified water, re‑insert the plunger, shake vigorously for 1 min, and push the liquid through the Sterivex filter (pressure filtration). Repeat the water‑add‑shake‑filter step once more to filter a total of 100 mL.

steps.title: Preserve filtered material
steps.instruction: After filtration, add 2 mL RNAlater (Thermo Fisher Scientific) to the Sterivex cartridge via the inlet using a disposable pipette (E‑243, Nihon Medical Science, Inc.) and store the cartridge in a refrigerator until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Gravity‑filter stemflow from bag
steps.instruction: Perform gravity filtration of the stemflow collected in the plastic bag according to the method of reference [13] (e.g., pour the bag’s contents through a filter membrane).

steps.title: Extract eDNA from filters
steps.instruction: Remove RNAlater from each Sterivex cartridge, homogenize trapped lichen fragments, and extract eDNA using the protocol of Miya et al. (2016) with minor modifications.

steps.title: First‑round PCR amplification
steps.instruction:
Set up a single 1st‑PCR reaction multiplexing the two primer sets (ITS‑PALichen and ITS‑PHLichen) that amplify ~170 bp ITS fragments of foliose lichens; use the primer sequences: 
ITS‑PALichenF = FACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCTNNNNNNCAACTCTTCACCCTGTGTGT
ITS‑PALichenR = GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCTNNNNNNATCGCATTTCGCTGCGTTCT
ITS‑PHLichenF = FACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCTNNNNNNTCTAACCGGCCTCAACTCTT
ITS‑PHLichenR = GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCTNNNNNNGATGCCAGAACCAAGAGATC.

steps.title: Second‑round PCR and indexing
steps.instruction: Perform a 2nd‑PCR to attach unique index combinations and Illumina adapter sequences to both ends of each amplified fragment.

steps.title: Pool libraries and sequence
steps.instruction: Combine the 18 indexed PCR products into a single pool and sequence on an Illumina MiSeq using a MiSeq Reagent Kit v2 (150 bp × 2 paired‑end).

steps.title: Process sequencing data
steps.instruction: Trim raw reads, discard erroneous sequences, and analyze with PMiFish; retain reads ≥98 % identity, exclude MOTUs with <0.01 % of total reads (<12 reads), reconstruct genus‑level phylogenies for remaining MOTUs, and revise taxonomic assignments as described in references [8, 18].
